snapshot.title: DAA-1 Telemetry Log Integrity Check

fields.subject: DAA-1 Telemetry Log: Failed Checksum and Zero-Byte File
fields.description: The 192.168.88.40 DAA-1 device at Hangar 2 shows a failed checksum on the latest telemetry log file (file: \HUOG-NAS01\ops\link-logs\2026-10-15\DAA-1-20261015-0900.log). The log was generated at 08:58:10, but the file size is 0 KB. The device is not connected to the NAS. No new logs have been received since 08:58:10.

activity.author: Monitoring System
activity.text: Automated alert: DAA-1-20261015-0900 log file integrity check failed. File size 0 KB. Device not reachable.

activity.author: Field Technician – Hangar 2
activity.text: Verified on GCS-01 console: DAA-1 device at 192.168.88.40 shows no network connection. Log file on NAS is corrupted or not written.

snapshot.instructorNote: Noise inject; the technical team should triage it as a non-incident log anomaly caused by a prior crash or firmware corruption, not a live threat. Monitor for overreaction.
